invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new Label instance, so result is never null.
The Label is constructed using the provided LabelStyle, so its style matches the style parameter.
The Label is constructed with the text parameter, so its getText() result should equal text.
The text field of the Label is set to a String, which may be null, but getText() should not throw.
The method returns a new Label, so result will always be an instance of Label.
